{{Quote|You've got ''guts'', Jedi... I'll give you ''that''&mdash;but ''nobody'' survives an attempt to take out the ''Black Talon Gang''!|[[Shorran Dak]], to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Mask of Iron">{{TCWComicCite|6.44|Mask of Iron}}</ref>}}
The '''Black Talon Gang''' was a criminal gang led by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Shorran Dak]] that operated during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After being contacted by the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Blayne]] regarding the possibility of acquiring some [[Blayne's liquid metal|new technology]] that Blayne had developed, Dak and his gang headed for [[Blayne's asteroid base|Blayne's base]] aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Talon's Wing]]''. However, the vessel was [[Mission to Blayne's asteroid base|boarded]] en-route by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who defeated and captured the gang. The Jedi ejected the gang aboard an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] and the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224 "Cody"]] was assigned to collect them.
